title: DECSET 1070 — Use private color registers for sixel
summary: CSI ? 1070 h enables private color registers for sixel graphics. CSI ? 1070 l disables it.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 1070 h private color registers for sixel

gotchas: Sixel graphics can use private color registers (not shared with the text palette).

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1070 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1070 h/l sequences.
